alphabet.name: Chinese Characters (Hanzi) + Pinyin
alphabet.note: Mandarin Chinese uses thousands of characters (hanzi). Pinyin is the romanisation system used for pronunciation. Basic literacy requires ~2000 characters.
alphabet.pinyin_initials: b p m f d t n l g k h j q x zh ch sh r z c s y w
alphabet.pinyin_finals: a o e i u ü ai ei ui ao ou iu ie üe er an en in un ün ang eng ing ong
alphabet.note2: Pinyin has 21 initials (consonants) and 35 finals (vowels/endings). Tones are essential — same syllable with different tones means different words.
